narration.text: But the first time a dark cloud gathered over the hills, imagine the fear. Would the water come back? Every child who had heard the stories would look up and wonder.
And I will establish my covenant with you; neither shall all flesh be cut off any more by the waters of a flood; neither shall there any more be a flood to destroy the earth.
I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.
And there it was, for the very first time: a bow of colour, bending over the whole sky. Not a weapon pointed at us. A war bow, hung up.
And the bow shall be in the cloud; and I will look upon it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is upon the earth.
Read that again. The sign is not only for us to see. God says He Himself will look upon it, and remember. He holds the promise in His own hands.
Notice what the rainbow is. God hung up His own bow, pointing at the sky and not at us. Mercy is His idea.
